title: What to order at a kopitiam when you want to lose weight
intro: The kopitiam is where many Malaysians have breakfast and lunch. The menu has lots of soupy options that are actually weight-loss friendly. Calories below are estimates for typical servings.

best.name: 2 half-boiled eggs
best.why: High in protein and easy. A great breakfast pairing so you don't get hungry quickly.

best.name: Roti bakar kaya without butter (2 slices)
best.why: You don't have to give up your favourite toast, just skip the butter. Calories drop noticeably.

best.name: Kuey teow soup
best.why: Clear broth with a little meat or fish balls. Less oil than the fried version.

best.name: Yong tau foo soup (6-7 pieces)
best.why: You get to choose. Add more vegetables and tofu, fewer fried items.

best.name: Wantan mee soup
best.why: The soup version is lighter than the dry version coated in oil and sauce.

best.name: Chicken rice (steamed chicken, skin removed, half rice)
best.why: You still get your favourite chicken rice, just tweaked a little. You get protein, calories stay in check.

careful.name: Roti bakar kaya with butter (2 slices)
careful.why: Thick butter adds fat. Tasty, but if it's every morning, it adds up.

careful.name: Char kuey teow
careful.why: Fried with lots of oil and lard. Better shared or eaten once in a while.

careful.name: Full chicken rice (oily rice, roasted chicken with skin)
careful.why: The rice is cooked with oil and chicken skin is high in fat.

careful.name: Curry mee
careful.why: Thick santan broth. Filling, but high in calories for one bowl.

careful.name: Regular kopi or teh with milk
careful.why: Condensed milk. If you drink it 2-3 times a day, it adds up fast.

hacks: Order 'kopi o kosong' (black coffee, no sugar) or 'kopi c kurang manis' (coffee with evaporated milk, less sweet).
Ask for 'roti bakar kaya, tak mau butter' (no butter) or 'kaya sikit sahaja' (just a little kaya).
Choose the soup version over the fried or dry version.
For curry mee, eat the noodles and toppings, leave some of the broth.
Add half-boiled eggs for protein so you stay full until lunch.
drink: Kopi o kosong or teh o kosong (no sugar, no milk), hot or iced. If you need milk, ask for kopi c kurang manis (with evaporated milk, less sweet).

faq.q: What does the most balanced kopitiam breakfast look like?
faq.a: For example, 2 half-boiled eggs, 1-2 slices of roti bakar kaya without butter and kopi o kosong. You get protein, carbs, and calories stay in check.

faq.q: Do I need to finish the soup?
faq.a: Clear soup is okay. Curry or santan broth is higher in calories, so leave some if you want to save calories.
